purpose: Record whether current corpus documents have an independent machine-readable source with semantic fields that overlap extracted values.

contract.independence: Paper source text and OCR-derived identifiers do not qualify as an independent reference.
contract.mapping: An adapter is eligible only when stable semantic keys can be authored without borrowing the uncertain OCR key or value under test.
contract.override: Only an exact independent reference may supply a replacement value; scientific and internal consistency checks remain support or review evidence.

candidates.reason: The current metadata contains no BFD family, and its other ECP families do not identify the tabulated energies, molecular errors, or timings extracted from the BFD paper.
PySCF ships machine-readable BFD basis and pseudopotential parameters, while the extracted paper tables contain energy errors, molecular properties, and timings rather than those parameters.
The current QMCPACK documentation still points to this historical BFD source, but the target now returns 404 and cannot back a reproducible adapter.
The bundle contains manuscript source and figure PDFs but no independent CSV, JSON, or tabular supplement. Re-reading the same manuscript source would not independently verify extracted values.
